summary: Comprehensive backend regression suite (32 pytest tests) + frontend smoke. 31/32 backend tests pass. Critical flows verified: auth (admin+operator), players CRUD, point structures, tournaments + entries with rebuy/addon/super_addon/bonus, charge totals (buy-in 120, full 380), summary (gross/rake/prize_pool), prize distribution, cashier (cash + debt + debt_payment reduction), debt-block on entry creation (409) and allow_debt bypass, cash tables full lifecycle (open/seat clamp/waitlist/close), rankings (with filter), dashboard summary + revenue, RBAC for admin-only mutations. Frontend login, navigation, BRL pt-BR formatting, and operator RBAC nav hiding all working.

minor.issue: Brute-force lockout (429 after 5 fails) NOT triggering when accessed via public preview URL. After 7 consecutive failed attempts with same email, all responses returned 401 — none 429. Root cause: rate-limit identifier is built from request.client.host which behind k8s/ingress is the immediate proxy IP and likely varies per request (so identifier is not stable). Fix: parse X-Forwarded-For header (or trust proxy and use forwarded chain) to derive a stable client IP; alternatively key the lockout solely by email.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid per spec — browsers will reject Set-Cookie/withCredentials when Access-Control-Allow-Origin is '*'. It happens to work today only because both apps are served from the same origin; if the FE is ever hit cross-origin, cookies will fail. Fix: set CORS_ORIGINS to explicit origin (FRONTEND_URL is already in .env).

Implementation calls tournament_summary(tid) directly without the user dependency arg; works because the unused _ parameter receives a Depends sentinel and is never read. Fragile — extract a private async helper to compute totals and reuse it in both the endpoint and prize-distribution.

issues: Date range inputs use the browser's NATIVE date picker (mm/dd/yyyy placeholder). Per design guidelines and pt-BR locale, replace with shadcn Calendar/DatePicker component using dd/mm/yyyy display.
Recharts ResponsiveContainer logs width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on initial mount. Functional but noisy console — set explicit minHeight on the chart wrapper.

action_items: Fix brute-force lockout: derive client IP from X-Forwarded-For (or key on email alone) so rate limit actually triggers behind ingress.
Tighten CORS: set CORS_ORIGINS to the explicit FRONTEND_URL when allow_credentials=True (current '*' is unsafe and spec-invalid).
Replace native HTML date inputs in Rankings with shadcn Calendar (pt-BR dd/mm/yyyy).
Refactor prize-distribution endpoint to use an internal helper instead of calling the public tournament_summary route function.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1116 lines — split into routers/{auth,players,tournaments,cashier,cash_tables,rankings,dashboard}.py for maintainability.
tournament_summary is invoked as a plain function from set_prize_distribution; the dependency parameter is bypassed. Use a private async function.
_recalc_entry uses Python sum on float charges — fine for now but consider Decimal for monetary precision.
No pagination on list endpoints (.to_list(2000/5000)); will not scale.
secure=True, samesite='none' cookies require HTTPS — OK for preview, but document this for self-hosted setups.
login_attempts collection has no TTL index — entries live forever. Add a TTL (e.g., 30 min) on created_at after migrating it to a Date type.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed players/tournaments/tables and tear them down. Persisted residual data may exist if a test crashes mid-run; safe because of TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is comprehensive — re-run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Frontend smoke verified login + nav + RBAC. The single remaining backend failure (brute-force lockout) requires a server-side fix (X-Forwarded-For). Did NOT do deep frontend e2e (creating tournament UI flow, rebuy/addon clicks, paying charges through the Cashier UI) — recommended next.
rca of the issue: Brute-force lockout: identifier = f"{ip}:{email}" with ip=request.client.host. Behind kubernetes ingress, the upstream client.host the FastAPI app sees is the in-cluster proxy address which can rotate between requests (or be the same but with X-Real-IP varying). The login_attempts inserts then carry different identifiers for each request, so count_documents per identifier never reaches 5. Mitigation: read X-Forwarded-For first hop (or simply key the throttle by email to be safe even without forwarded headers).
